question.prompt: A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward. Given a string s, return true if it is a palindrome, or false otherwise.
expectedPoints: Two pointer approach moving inwards from both ends
Skipping non-alphanumeric characters without allocating extra strings
O(N) time and O(1) space complexity
commonMistakes: RegEx allocation creating large unnecessary string copies
Failing on empty strings or strings with only punctuation

transcript: Candidate: For palindrome, I will take the string and reverse it into a new string using string concatenation in a loop. Then I do if s equals reversed return true. Interviewer: How do you handle punctuation and uppercase letters? Candidate: Oh I forgot about spaces and commas. Maybe I can replace them manually or just ignore it. I am not sure about alphanumeric checks in standard library. Time complexity is O(1) because string reversal is instant.
notes: Incorrect complexity assertion (reversal is instant), missed core punctuation requirement, allocates unnecessary memory.
